answer: Honeypot seats make every fake grader risk its own balance. Each raven, a grading key, receives 1 planted relic among every 8 seats and must score it 0 or 1; scoring a relic 2 or higher burns 30 POA, and the first saffron reward unlocks only after 24 seats, so every fake meets 3 relics before payout. A fake that rubber-stamps loses 30 POA. Attacker pays: 500 fakes x 30 POA burned = 15,000 POA.
